newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's CFE, GMD, Techint in $250 mln carbon deal.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's CFE, GMD, Techint in $250 mln carbon deal.

text.p: Grupo Mexicano de Desarollo said on Sunday it reached a $250 million investment accord with the Federal Electricity Commission (CFE) and Italy's Techint to supply carbon to a thermo-electric plant in southern Mexico.

The CFE and a consortium comprised of GMD and Techint "established an accord for the construction of a private project for supplying the primary material (carbon) to the Presidente Plutarcho Elias Calles thermo-electric plant in Petacalco, Guerrero," a GMD statement said.

The statement said the project would include building a carbon storage terminal in the Guerrero port of Lazaro Cardenas, and that it will include modifications to the port "which could turn it into the one with most maritime commercial activity in the country."
Building the terminal will take an estimated 27 months and create 4,000 jobs, GMD said.
The Petacalco plant has an installed capacity of generating 2,100 megawatts.
